params.recipient: The address to receive the swept tokens.
params.token: The held token to sweep. Must not be LAYER or WETH —        those have dedicated processing paths (`processBurnLayer`,        `processBurnWeth`).

returns._0: The balance held by this contract.

initialize(address,address,address,addre.details: The pool key's currencies must be exactly (LAYER, WETH) in either         sort order. The function rejects any other configuration.

params.canonicalPoolKey_: The PoolKey of the LAYER/WETH pool.
params.weth_: The WETH address on this chain.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

processBurnLayer().details: Reverts with `NothingToBurn` if balance is zero.

processBurnWeth(uint256).details: Wraps any native ETH in the contract to WETH first, so callers         can poll based on WETH balance. Approves the universal router         via Permit2 for the exact amount before each call.

params.minLayerOut: Minimum LAYER expected from the swap (slippage bound).

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.newFloor: Minimum LAYER out per WETH, scaled by 1e18.

params.newThreshold: The new threshold in WETH wei.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

MIN_THRESHOLD_FLOOR().notice: Lower bound for `minProcessThreshold` — guards against being set so         low that processing becomes net-negative due to gas + slippage.

adminSweepHeldToken(address,address,uint.notice: Sweeps a held (non-LAYER, non-WETH) ERC20 to a chosen recipient.         Admin only. The contract never converts or burns these tokens         on its own — `adminSweepHeldToken` is the only way to move them.         A future protocol upgrade may add permissionless conversion         (artcoin → WETH → LAYER) by replacing this contract via         `ProtocolFeeController.setBurnRouter`.

canonicalPoolKey().notice: The canonical LAYER/WETH pool key. Immutable after init.

heldBalance(address).notice: Returns the contract's balance of an arbitrary token. Convenience         view for monitoring held non-LAYER, non-WETH tokens. For LAYER         and WETH balances, prefer `status()` which also returns the         WETH-burn readiness flag.

initialize(address,address,address,addre.notice: One-time setup binding the router to LAYER, WETH, and the canonical         LAYER/WETH pool. After this call, `layerToken` cannot change.

layerToken().notice: The LAYER token address, set at `initialize`. Immutable after.

minLayerOutPerWeth().notice: Owner-set minimum LAYER output required per 1 WETH input.

minProcessThreshold().notice: Minimum WETH balance required before `processBurn` will execute a swap.

processBurnLayer().notice: Burns all LAYER currently held by this contract. Permissionless.

processBurnWeth(uint256).notice: Swaps the contract's WETH balance for LAYER, then burns the LAYER.         Permissionless. The caller supplies `minLayerOut` for slippage         protection — the V4 router reverts if not met.

requiredMinLayerOutForCurrentWethBalance.notice: Returns the current minimum LAYER output required for the         contract's whole WETH balance.

requiredMinLayerOutForWethAmount(uint256.notice: Returns the minimum LAYER output required for a given WETH input.

setMinLayerOutPerWeth(uint256).notice: Updates the minimum acceptable LAYER output per 1 WETH input.         Admin only. Set to 0 to pause WETH processing.

setMinThreshold(uint256).notice: Updates the minimum WETH threshold required to swap. Admin only.

status().notice: Returns LAYER and WETH balances and whether processing is ready.

universalRouter().notice: The Uniswap Universal Router. Immutable after init.

weth().notice: The WETH address on this chain, set at `initialize`. Immutable after.

wethIsCurrency0().notice: True if `weth` sorts as currency0 in the canonical pool.
